zh.title: 瑞安航空FY2026附加服務收入達49.9億歐元 每客約27美元
zh.summary: 瑞安航空2026財年附加服務收入49.9億歐元；每名乘客平均貢獻27美元。
body: 根據外媒Simple Flying發布的資訊，超低成本航空公司瑞安航空（Ryanair）於2026財年（FY2026）一共錄得49.9億歐元的附加服務收入（ancillary revenue）。
統計顯示，瑞安航空平均每位乘客貢獻約27美元的附加收益。相關收入涵蓋旅客購買行李額度、預選座位、購買機上餐飲項目，以及其他各類額外服務費用。
根據相關數據，附加服務收入在瑞安航空的營運模式中佔有顯著地位，該公司透過行李、座位與餐飲等多元附加選項，有效提高平均每位旅客的總收益。

en.title: Ryanair Generates €4.99B In Ancillary Revenue For FY2026, Averaging $27 Per Passenger
en.summary: Ryanair recorded €4.99 billion in FY2026 ancillary revenue; averaging about $27 per passenger from extra services.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying, European low-cost carrier Ryanair generated €4.99 billion in total ancillary revenue during fiscal year 2026 (FY2026). Ancillary revenue includes all income generated from services beyond the baseline passenger airfare.

The airline earned approximately $27 per passenger from ancillary offerings over the same fiscal period. Key revenue drivers identified include charges for checked baggage, optional seat assignments, onboard food and drinks, and additional extra travel options.

The financial results demonstrate how non-ticket passenger fees contribute significantly to Ryanair's overall earnings model, with options such as reserved seating, baggage allowances, and inflight refreshments generating consistent revenue across its passenger flights.

zh.title: 馬來西亞暫停飛行醫生服務 直升機墜毀五死
zh.summary: 衛生部長宣布暫停砂拉越飛行醫生服務；直升機墜毀五死調查中
body: 馬來西亞衛生部長祖基菲里·阿末於2026年9月10日宣布，因直升機墜毀造成五人死亡，暫停砂拉越飛行醫生服務進行安全檢討。事故發生在9月8日，地點靠近婆羅洲砂拉越的龍勒朗機場。
涉事直升機為Layang-Layang Aerospace營運的BO-105（註冊編號9M-LLF），執行從美里出發服務偏遠社區的醫療任務。社交媒體影片顯示直升機飛行中拖曳濃灰煙霧，隨後墜毀並爆燃起火。
遇難者包括機師扎伊諾·阿菲克·比·沙姆、醫療官艾努爾·巴拉·卡馬魯丁、助理醫療官亞歷山大·阿迪特·亨利，以及護士黛布拉·莫塞特和潔西·帕亞·喬克。
民航局局長諾茲曼·馬哈茲指出，營運商已自主停飛旗下所有裝配勞斯萊斯250系列引擎的BO-105直升機及其他機型，屬預防性措施，不代表引擎或其他部件導致事故。民航局正監督檢查並審查機組、營運商與飛行員記錄。
交通部轄下的空難調查局已介入調查，副部長哈斯比·哈比波拉表示調查人員9月11日已抵達現場。預計初步報告30天內出爐，最終報告一年內完成。
衛生部將檢視安全、合約、監督機制及替代方案，以維持偏遠地區醫療服務。緊急醫療撤離將透過消拯局合作持續進行，亦在討論軍方協助運送急診患者。
意外也影響定期客運，AirBorneo因龍勒朗機場暫時關閉商業運作，將原訂9月9日美里往返龍勒朗的兩班航班改至9月11日執飛。

en.title: Malaysia suspends Flying Doctor flights after Sarawak helicopter crash kills five
en.summary: Health minister halts Sarawak air medical service; crash investigation underway
body: Malaysia Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad announced on September 10, 2026 the suspension of Flying Doctor Service flights in Sarawak for a safety review after a helicopter crash killed five people two days earlier near Long Lellang airstrip on Borneo.

The aircraft involved was a BO-105 registered 9M-LLF operated by Layang-Layang Aerospace, conducting a medical mission from Miri to remote communities including Long Lellang on September 8. Video posted to social media showed the helicopter flying under control but trailing thick gray smoke before it crashed and burst into flames.
The five victims were pilot Captain Zainol Afiq Bee Sham, medical officer Dr Ainul Baraah Kamaruddin, assistant medical officer Alexson Adit Henry, and nurses Debra Moset and Jessie Paya Jok.

Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia CEO Captain Norazman Mahmud said the operator voluntarily grounded its BO-105 fleet and other aircraft using Rolls-Royce 250-series engines as a precaution, stressing this did not establish an engine or component cause. CAAM is monitoring inspections and reviewing aircraft, operator and pilot records.

The Air Accident Investigation Bureau under the Transport Ministry is investigating. Deputy Transport Minister Hasbi Habibollah said investigators were at the site on September 11. An initial report is expected within 30 days and a final report within a year.

The Health Ministry will examine safety, contracts, oversight and alternative ways to reach remote communities. Emergency medical evacuations will continue through cooperation with the Fire and Rescue Department, and military assistance for urgent patient transport is under discussion.

The crash also disrupted scheduled passenger services. AirBorneo said Long Lellang airstrip was temporarily closed to commercial operations, prompting it to move two September 9 flights between Miri and Long Lellang to September 11.

zh.title: 杜拜機場評估燃料槽地下化以強化韌性
zh.summary: 杜拜機場評估燃料槽地下化；強化關鍵基建
body: 杜拜機場公司（Dubai Airports）執行長保羅·格里菲斯表示，規劃單位正檢討是否將具風險的基礎設施（包括航空燃油儲存）設置於地下，或強化以因應未來無人機與飛彈攻擊，此舉適用於杜拜世界中心機場（Al Maktoum International Airport（DWC）, DWC）的興建設計。
此一構想源自於杜拜國際機場（DXB；Dubai International Airport，DXB）在2026年衝突期間，地上燃油槽遭到攻擊、一度暫停營運的經驗。格里菲效表示，該事件凸顯了將關鍵基礎設施地下化或強化「韌性」的必要性。
杜拜當局計劃將營運從杜拜國際機場轉移至擴建後的阿拉丁國際機場，因此有機會將此衝突學得的教訓融入下一代航空樞紐的設計中。

en.title: Dubai weighs underground fuel tanks at Al Maktoum after DXB conflict strikes
en.summary: Dubai Airports considers underground fuel storage; hardening critical infrastructure
body: Dubai Airports is considering placing aviation fuel storage underground and hardening other critical infrastructure at Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC), Chief Executive Paul Griffiths said, following disruptions at Dubai International Airport (DXB) during a 2026 conflict.

The proposal follows an event in which above-ground fuel tanks at Dubai International Airport were struck, forcing the airport to halt operations temporarily. Griffiths said the airport resumed flights rapidly after the incident.

Under the plan to transfer operations from Dubai International Airport to an expanded Al Maktoum International Airport, planners are examining whether vulnerable infrastructure, including aviation fuel storage, should be placed underground or reinforced against future drone and missile attacks.
